bio.text: Paige Cognetti is the Democratic nominee for Pennsylvania's 8th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election, having advanced from the May 19, 2026 primary.
She is the Mayor of Scranton; according to the city, she was sworn in on January 6, 2020, and won re-election to a full term in November 2021.

Before becoming mayor she served as a director on the Scranton School Board, advised the Pennsylvania Auditor General, and was a senior advisor to the Under Secretary for International Affairs at the U.S. Treasury Department in the Obama administration.
She holds an MBA from Harvard Business School and a BA in English literature from the University of Oregon, and grew up in Beaverton, Oregon, according to the city.
